svg.title: Сведение гантелей перед грудью стоя — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Fix RIGHT pose only. Exactly TWO separate vertically oriented dumbbells, one in each hand, no third central disk. Arms reach forward so hands meet in front of chest at shoulder height. Elbows softly bent, not curled to chest. Keep left pose. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
